text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The New Year's Eve bells rang, and it was 
the dead of night, just having welcomed 
New Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll go take out this trash over here! Um, 
next should we wipe the windows and 
sashes, and maybe wash the curtains 
too...?!
choice_data_list: At this point, let's just do it all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If you're wondering why we're 
scrambling around doing a major clean-up 
at this hour—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... This might be kind of a rude 
question, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...The trainer's office hasn't had its 
year-end spring cleaning yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few hours ago, Win Variation had pointed 
that out to me when she came to give her 
New Year's greetings.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could it be, by any chance... that 
you've been kind of busy lately?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the truth was that work had piled up, 
and even the daily cleaning had been 
neglected.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean, well... If it's not too much 
trouble, that is—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Can I go ahead and start cleaning now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, an impromptu spring cleaning 
began.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I ended up dragging you along 
after all.
choice_data_list:
No, no, this is my trainer's office, after 
all...

No, no, it's my office as your Trainer, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly leave her to do it all 
by herself. That said, the more you clean, 
the more things you find to clean—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Do this, do that... ...G-Glad I got 
permission to stay out, though. Still, 
will I really be done before sunrise...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not about *if* we'll finish! We 
*have* to finish it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Since I dragged you into this too, 
Trainer, I have to give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... alright then, Trainer! Let's divide 
up the work and be efficient...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
For now, which would you prefer: carrying 
this oversized trash, sitting down to 
organize the paperwork, or going to wash 
the curtains?
choice_data_list: I'll go haul the oversized trash.
I'll wash the curtains at the laundromat.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Got it! It's pretty heavy, so please be 
careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The oversized trash was bigger than 
expected, and carrying it took far longer 
than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I hurried back to the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Heave, ho! Yup, that's nice and clean. 
Now, next is... over there. Gotta keep 
going!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Oh!? Welcome back, ssir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Whoa, you saw that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod and look around. The cleaning had 
progressed quite a bit compared to before 
we left.
choice_data_list: It's all nice and shiny now.
It's all nice and shiny now, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... Trainer-san, you're handling 
such a tough task for us, so I thought I 
should get ahead with the cleaning to make 
up for it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. I pushed myself just a little 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, thanks to all our hard 
work, the cleaning safely finished before 
dawn.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Looking forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I check and sort through the towering pile 
of documents on the desk, one by one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Things I need, things I don't. Things 
I'll need later. Things to keep, things to 
double-check. Things that need to be 
sent—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's entirely my own fault, but... the 
monotonous work is gradually making my 
eyelids heavy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here you go! I'll leave it over 
there for you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I thought you might be getting tired.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, we've only got a little more to go, so 
let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Please be careful not to spill 
anything on the documents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, thanks to all our hard 
work, the cleaning safely finished before 
dawn.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ...There's quite a lot here, 
though. Mind if I come along too?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Understood. I'll leave it in 
your hands, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Is what I said, but just as she 
feared, the huge pile of curtains was 
heavier than I had imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While carrying it with frequent rests...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Found you! A-Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I did trust you, but... I figured 
carrying stuff was more up my alley, so I 
just ended up following you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, can I carry half of it for 
ya? ...Ah, I'm totally fine carrying all 
of it too, though!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ehehe. You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, thanks to all our hard 
work, the cleaning safely finished before 
dawn.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"‘...Up next, a special feature on this 
year's most talked-about Umamusume! 
Leading the pack is Buena Vista, an 
Umamusume said to define an entire era—’"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning. Sorry for turning on the 
TV without asking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I woke up on the couch in the trainer's 
office. It seems I had fallen asleep 
before I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There are some light snacks, so please 
help yourself. Oh, and also, the room is a 
bit... umm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only then do I realize. The neatly cleaned 
Trainer's office had been further 
decorated for New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! I was the one who said I wanted 
to clean at such a weird hour, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If a new year is coming, I wanted to 
welcome it with a fresh start. I'm glad 
you liked it...
choice_data_list: Shion really has her act together...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ah, um, I'm sorry. ...I was trying 
to cover it up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This year is, well... special... Because 
the Classic campaign is starting...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I tend to overthink things a lot, and my 
head is always a cluttered mess. So 
because of that, I at least wanted to keep 
my surroundings tidy."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I felt that if I did that, I'd be able to 
start the new year with a bit more peace 
of mind.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: If I can stay calm and challenge them—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Though she only recently debuted, her 
abilities are on a completely different 
level, drawing massive attention!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
"Her skill is obvious, but she also just 
has this presence about her. The way she 
speaks, the way she carries herself..."

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, she is a very eye-catching 
Umamusume. There are even rumors that she 
might sweep the entire Classic circuit 
this year..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...A-Ahaha. Speak of the devil, huh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's only been a year, that 
guy just keeps climbing higher and higher, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Orfevre fully demonstrated her 
immense talent during the Junior Class. 
That is precisely why she is creating such 
a huge sensation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That said—
choice_data_list: It's okay, the real deal starts now.
It's okay, it's just getting started.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic year is just getting started. 
Nobody knows what's going to happen yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... no, without a doubt. If it's 
her, she can overtake Orfevre and take 
center stage.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're totally right! The curtains 
haven't even gone up yet, no point moping 
around...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Alright, let's do this! I'm 
giving this year everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The future is an unknown. Let's move 
forward positively." Pledging this to one 
another, we welcomed the new year.
